t: HSS-tin metal drill bits are ideal for fast clean drilling with maximum surface quality. The flat wood drill bits are ideal for larger holes in all kinds of wood and are easy to handle due to their 3-tip design. Hexagonal shank prevents the bit from slipping in the power tool. These drill bits have an impact-resistant tungsten carbide tip which ensures a long lifetime. The magnetic universal holder enables the user to change between screwdriver bits effortlessly.
b: Contents: 11 HSS Metal Drill Bits, 6 TC Masonry Drill Bits, 5 Wood Drill Bits, 2 Spade Bits, 18 Screwdriver Bits, 3 Nutsetters, Diameter Gauge, Knife, Adaptor for Nutsetters, Universal Bit Holder & Co
Suitable For Use with 3-Jaw Chuck Machines on Rotary & Impact Modes
